discrepancyAudit.rootCause: The outer glass sphere rim sits slightly above canvas center (y~580.4 px) because lower Resident ribbons (C01 & G02) extend ~210 px below the sphere while upper ribbons extend ~140 px above. Historical record (620.4, 605.5) measured the combined orb+ribbons visual composition center (bbox center 580.0, 626.0), whereas (619.82, 580.35) matches the true outer glass sphere rim circle.

E01_outer_glass_sphere.ambiguityNotes: Outer glass rim crisp across 80%+ of circumference; minor ribbon overlaps at 3:30 and 10:30.

E02_inner_glass_wall.ambiguityNotes: Double-wall glass shell visible around left/bottom/right perimeter; blends with cavity rim near top.

E03_upper_cavity.ambiguityNotes: Upper translucent crystal dome pocket contains dark crystal cavity plus refracted golden 10:30 flare and inner cyan rim.

quadraticFit.formula: y(x) = a*x^2 + b*x + c in normalized sphere frame (+Y up)

E04_liquid_interface_contour.ambiguityNotes: Asymmetric curved 3D liquid-crystal interface dipping near x=+0.09 and curving smoothly upward toward left 10:30 flare.

E05_emerald_folds.ambiguityNotes: Sculpted 3D emerald-jade folded curtains on left (7-10) and right (1:30-4:30) framing dark sapphire core.

E07_aqua_pocket.ambiguityNotes: Focused lower-center/right (5-7 o'clock) luminous clear aqua water body, decoupled from optical caustics.

E10_gold_residents_combined.ambiguityNotes: Combined projection of A01 (10:00-12:30 crown) and A02 (front-bottom sweep + 3:00-4:30 sculptural flare); NOT a uniform symmetric oval.

E11_cyan_resident_c01.ambiguityNotes: Open-ended crystal-clear ice-blue liquid glass band wrapping left-front-bottom smoothly without 5:00 V-kink.

E12_green_residents_g01_g02.ambiguityNotes: Translucent olive-emerald botanical silk leaves (G01 top-right trailing, G02 lower-left draping).

E13_background_gradient.ambiguityNotes: Deep dark teal-cyan underwater gradient backdrop with subtle soft radial halo behind orb.
